import secrets
from django.conf import settings
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import F
from django.utils import timezone
from common.fields import SafeJsonField
from common.phone import normalize_ph_phone

SUFFIX_CHOICES = [("", "None"), ("Jr.", "Jr."), ("Sr.", "Sr."), ("II", "II"), ("III", "III"), ("IV", "IV")]
USER_ROLE_CHOICES = [
    ("ADMIN", "System Administrator"),
    ("PRINCIPAL", "School Principal"),
    ("DEPT_HEAD", "Department Head"),
    ("FACULTY", "Teacher / Adviser"),
    ("PARENT", "Parent / Guardian"),
]


class TeacherProfile(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    employee_id = models.CharField(max_length=50, unique=True, db_index=True)
    first_name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    middle_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    last_name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    suffix = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=SUFFIX_CHOICES, blank=True, default="")
    position = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    department = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    contact_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default="")
    email = models.EmailField(max_length=150, blank=True, default="")

    photo = models.ImageField(upload_to="faculty/", null=True, blank=True)
    photo_updated_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    can_teach = models.BooleanField(default=True, db_index=True)
    qr_token = models.CharField(max_length=128, unique=True, null=True, blank=True, db_index=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    bound_device_id = models.CharField(max_length=128, blank=True, null=True, unique=True)
    device_model = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, null=True)
    device_bound_at = models.DateTimeField(blank=True, null=True)

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name="created_teachers"
    )
    updated_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name="updated_teachers"
    )

    class Meta:
        db_table = "faculty_profiles"
        ordering = ["last_name", "first_name"]

    @property
    def full_name(self) -> str:
        mid = f" {self.middle_name[:1]}." if self.middle_name else ""
        suf = f" {self.suffix}" if self.suffix else ""
        return f"{self.first_name}{mid} {self.last_name}{suf}".strip()

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.contact_number:
            self.contact_number = normalize_ph_phone(self.contact_number)
        if not self.qr_token:
            self.qr_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.full_name} ({self.employee_id})"


class UserProfile(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    user = models.OneToOneField(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="profile")
    teacher = models.OneToOneField(
        TeacherProfile,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        db_column="faculty_id",
        related_name="account",
    )
    role = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=USER_ROLE_CHOICES, default="FACULTY")
    phone_number = models.CharField(max_length=30, blank=True, default="", db_index=True)
    avatar = models.ImageField(upload_to="avatars/", null=True, blank=True)
    push_token = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, null=True)
    is_teaching = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    is_profile_completed = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    failed_attempts = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    locked_until = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "user_profiles"

    def is_locked(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.locked_until and timezone.now() < self.locked_until)

    def record_failed_attempt(self):
        now = timezone.now()
        if self.locked_until and now >= self.locked_until:
            UserProfile.objects.filter(pk=self.pk).update(failed_attempts=1, locked_until=None)
            self.failed_attempts = 1
            self.locked_until = None
            return
        UserProfile.objects.filter(pk=self.pk).update(failed_attempts=F("failed_attempts") + 1)
        self.refresh_from_db(fields=["failed_attempts"])
        if self.failed_attempts >= 5:
            self.locked_until = now + timezone.timedelta(minutes=15)
            self.save(update_fields=["locked_until"])

    def reset_failed_attempts(self):
        if self.failed_attempts > 0 or self.locked_until is not None:
            UserProfile.objects.filter(pk=self.pk).update(failed_attempts=0, locked_until=None)

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.phone_number:
            self.phone_number = normalize_ph_phone(self.phone_number)
        if self.role == "PARENT":
            self.is_teaching = False
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.core.cache import cache
from django.db.models import Q

from common.media import build_media_url
from common.permissions import get_user_role
from apps.school.models import ClassPeriod, Section
from apps.students.models import Enrollment
from .models import TeacherProfile, UserProfile


def resolve_teacher_for_user(user: User | None) -> TeacherProfile | None:
    if not user or not getattr(user, "is_authenticated", False):
        return None

    # Parents must never resolve to a TeacherProfile
    if get_user_role(user) == "PARENT":
        return None

    cache_key = f"accounts:teacher_for_user:{user.id}"
    cached_id = cache.get(cache_key)
    if cached_id is not None:
        if cached_id == 0:
            return None
        found = TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("account").filter(id=cached_id, is_active=True).first()
        if found:
            return found

    profile = UserProfile.objects.select_related("teacher").filter(user=user).first()
    if profile and getattr(profile, "teacher", None):
        teacher = profile.teacher
        if teacher and teacher.is_active:
            cache.set(cache_key, teacher.id, timeout=60)
            return teacher

    by_account = TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("account").filter(account__user=user, is_active=True).first()
    if by_account:
        cache.set(cache_key, by_account.id, timeout=60)
        return by_account

    lookup = Q()
    clean_username = str(getattr(user, "username", "") or "").strip()
    clean_email = str(getattr(user, "email", "") or "").strip()
    if clean_username:
        lookup |= Q(employee_id__iexact=clean_username)
    if clean_email:
        lookup |= Q(email__iexact=clean_email)

    if lookup:
        by_identity = (
            TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("account")
            .filter(lookup, is_active=True)
            .first()
        )
        if by_identity:
            cache.set(cache_key, by_identity.id, timeout=60)
            return by_identity

    cache.set(cache_key, 0, timeout=30)
    return None


def get_teacher_section_ids(teacher: TeacherProfile | None) -> set[int]:
    if not teacher:
        return set()

    cache_key = f"accounts:teacher_sections:{teacher.id}"
    cached = cache.get(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        return set(cached)

    advisory_ids = set(
        Section.objects.filter(adviser=teacher, is_active=True).values_list("id", flat=True)
    )
    period_sec_ids = set(
        ClassPeriod.objects.filter(teacher=teacher, is_active=True, section__is_active=True)
        .exclude(section_id__isnull=True)
        .values_list("section_id", flat=True)
    )
    combined = advisory_ids | period_sec_ids
    cache.set(cache_key, list(combined), timeout=30)
    return combined


def get_teacher_student_ids(teacher: TeacherProfile | None) -> set[int]:
    if not teacher:
        return set()

    section_ids = get_teacher_section_ids(teacher)
    if not section_ids:
        return set()

    return set(
        Enrollment.objects.filter(
            section_id__in=section_ids,
            status__in=["ENROLLED", "TRANSFERRED_IN"],
            student__is_active=True,
        ).values_list("student_id", flat=True)
    )


def build_user_session_payload(user: User, request=None) -> dict:
    """Delegates to accounts.services.build_user_session_payload to keep one canonical session format."""
    from .services import build_user_session_payload as _canonical_payload

    return _canonical_payload(user, request=request)

class UserAccountSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    role = serializers.CharField(required=False, default="FACULTY")
    is_teaching = serializers.BooleanField(required=False, default=True)
    employee_id = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    contact_number = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    department = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    position = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    photo = FlexibleImageField(required=False, allow_null=True)
    photo_url = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    password = serializers.CharField(write_only=True, required=False, allow_blank=True)

    class Meta:
        model = User
        fields = [
            "id", "username", "employee_id", "first_name", "last_name", "email",
            "contact_number", "department", "position", "role", "is_teaching",
            "photo", "photo_url", "is_active", "password",
        ]

    def get_photo_url(self, obj):
        prof = getattr(obj, "profile", None)
        if prof and prof.teacher and prof.teacher.photo:
            return build_media_url(prof.teacher.photo, self.context.get("request"))
        return build_media_url(prof.avatar if prof else None, self.context.get("request"))

    def to_representation(self, instance):
        data = super().to_representation(instance)
        prof = getattr(instance, "profile", None)
        teacher = prof.teacher if prof else None
        role = prof.role if prof else ("ADMIN" if instance.is_superuser else "FACULTY")
        is_teaching = False if role == "PARENT" else (prof.is_teaching if prof else True)
        phone = (prof.phone_number if prof else "") or (teacher.contact_number if teacher else "")

        data["role"] = role
        data["current_role"] = "FACULTY_ADMIN" if (role == "ADMIN" and is_teaching) else role
        data["is_teaching"] = is_teaching
        data["can_teach"] = is_teaching
        data["faculty_id"] = prof.teacher_id if prof else None
        data["employee_id"] = teacher.employee_id if teacher else instance.username
        data["contact_number"] = phone
        data["phone_number"] = phone
        data["department"] = teacher.department if teacher else ""
        data["position"] = teacher.position if teacher else role.title()
        data["full_name"] = teacher.full_name if teacher else (instance.get_full_name() or instance.username)
        return data

    @transaction.atomic
    def create(self, validated_data):
        password = validated_data.pop("password", "")
        raw_role = str(validated_data.pop("role", "FACULTY")).upper()
        role = "ADMIN" if raw_role == "FACULTY_ADMIN" else raw_role
        is_teaching = False if role == "PARENT" else bool(validated_data.pop("is_teaching", True))
        emp_id = str(validated_data.pop("employee_id", "") or validated_data["username"]).strip().upper()
        phone = normalize_ph_phone(validated_data.pop("contact_number", ""))
        dept = validated_data.pop("department", "Junior High School")
        pos = validated_data.pop("position", "Faculty I")
        photo = validated_data.pop("photo", None)

        user = User(**validated_data, is_staff=(role == "ADMIN"), is_superuser=(role == "ADMIN"))
        if password:
            user.set_password(password)
        else:
            user.set_unusable_password()
        user.save()

        profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.update_or_create(
            user=user,
            defaults={
                "role": role,
                "phone_number": phone,
                "is_teaching": is_teaching,
                "is_profile_completed": bool(user.first_name and user.last_name),
                **({"avatar": photo} if photo else {}),
            },
        )

        if role != "PARENT":
            teacher, _ = TeacherProfile.objects.update_or_create(
                employee_id=emp_id[:50],
                defaults={
                    "first_name": user.first_name or user.username,
                    "last_name": user.last_name or "Staff",
                    "email": user.email or "",
                    "contact_number": phone,
                    "department": dept,
                    "position": pos,
                    "can_teach": is_teaching,
                    "is_active": user.is_active,
                    "qr_token": secrets.token_urlsafe(24),
                },
            )
            profile.teacher = teacher
            profile.save(update_fields=["teacher"])
        return user

    @transaction.atomic
    def update(self, instance, validated_data):
        request = self.context.get("request")
        is_admin = bool(
            request and request.user.is_authenticated
            and (request.user.is_superuser or get_user_role(request.user) == "ADMIN")
        )

        password = validated_data.pop("password", "")
        raw_role = validated_data.pop("role", None)
        is_teaching = validated_data.pop("is_teaching", None)
        phone = validated_data.pop("contact_number", None)
        dept = validated_data.pop("department", None)
        pos = validated_data.pop("position", None)
        emp_id = validated_data.pop("employee_id", None)
        has_photo = "photo" in validated_data
        photo = validated_data.pop("photo", None)

        if not is_admin:
            validated_data.pop("is_active", None)
            raw_role = None

        for attr, val in validated_data.items():
            setattr(instance, attr, val)
        if password:
            instance.set_password(password)
        instance.save()

        profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=instance)
        if raw_role and is_admin:
            clean_role = str(raw_role).upper()
            profile.role = "ADMIN" if clean_role == "FACULTY_ADMIN" else clean_role
            instance.is_staff = profile.role == "ADMIN"
            instance.is_superuser = profile.role == "ADMIN"
            instance.save(update_fields=["is_staff", "is_superuser"])

        if is_teaching is not None and is_admin:
            profile.is_teaching = False if profile.role == "PARENT" else bool(is_teaching)
        if phone is not None:
            profile.phone_number = normalize_ph_phone(phone)
        if has_photo:
            profile.avatar = photo
        profile.is_profile_completed = bool(instance.first_name and instance.last_name)
        profile.save()

        if profile.teacher:
            t = profile.teacher
            t.first_name = instance.first_name or t.first_name
            t.last_name = instance.last_name or t.last_name
            t.email = instance.email or t.email
            if emp_id is not None and str(emp_id).strip():
                clean_emp = str(emp_id).strip().upper()[:50]
                if clean_emp != t.employee_id:
                    if TeacherProfile.objects.filter(employee_id__iexact=clean_emp).exclude(id=t.id).exists():
                        raise serializers.ValidationError({"employee_id": "Employee ID is already assigned to another faculty member."})
                    t.employee_id = clean_emp
            if phone is not None:
                t.contact_number = profile.phone_number
            if dept is not None:
                t.department = dept
            if pos is not None:
                t.position = pos
            if has_photo:
                if photo and hasattr(photo, "seek"):
                    photo.seek(0)
                t.photo = photo
            t.can_teach = profile.is_teaching
            t.is_active = instance.is_active
            t.save()
            profile.teacher = t

        instance.profile = profile
        cache.delete(user_session_cache_key(instance.id))
        return instance

from django.contrib.auth import authenticate, get_user_model
from django.contrib.auth.password_validation import validate_password

TEACHER_DROPDOWN_CACHE_KEYS = ["teachers:dropdown:active", "teachers:dropdown:all"]
VALID_SUFFIXES = {code for code, _ in SUFFIX_CHOICES}


def user_session_cache_key(user_id: int) -> str:
    return f"accounts:me:{user_id}"


def invalidate_user_and_teacher_caches(user_id: int | None = None, teacher_id: int | None = None) -> None:
    keys = list(TEACHER_DROPDOWN_CACHE_KEYS)
    if user_id:
        keys.append(user_session_cache_key(user_id))
        keys.append(f"accounts:teacher_for_user:{user_id}")
    if teacher_id:
        keys.append(f"accounts:teacher_sections:{teacher_id}")
    cache.delete_many(keys)


def build_user_session_payload(user, request=None) -> dict:
    cache_key = user_session_cache_key(user.id)
    cached = cache.get(cache_key)
    if cached is None:
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        profile = getattr(user, "profile", None)
        role = get_user_role(user)
        class_count = ClassPeriod.objects.filter(teacher=teacher, is_active=True).count() if teacher else 0
        can_teach = (
            False
            if role == "PARENT"
            else (bool(getattr(teacher, "can_teach", True)) and bool(getattr(profile, "is_teaching", True)))
        )
        full_name = teacher.full_name if teacher else (user.get_full_name() or user.username)
        photo_raw = teacher.photo if (teacher and teacher.photo) else (profile.avatar if profile else None)
        bound_id = getattr(teacher, "bound_device_id", None) if teacher else None

        cached = {
            "id": user.id,
            "username": user.username,
            "first_name": teacher.first_name if teacher else user.first_name,
            "middle_name": teacher.middle_name if teacher else "",
            "last_name": teacher.last_name if teacher else user.last_name,
            "suffix": getattr(teacher, "suffix", "") if teacher else "",
            "full_name": full_name,
            "faculty_name": full_name,
            "faculty_id": teacher.employee_id if teacher else user.username,
            "employee_id": teacher.employee_id if teacher else user.username,
            "faculty_pk": teacher.id if teacher else None,
            "email": (teacher.email if teacher else "") or user.email,
            "contact_number": teacher.contact_number if teacher else (profile.phone_number if profile else ""),
            "phone_number": profile.phone_number if profile else (teacher.contact_number if teacher else ""),
            "position": teacher.position if teacher else "",
            "department": teacher.department if teacher else "",
            "bound_device_id": bound_id,
            "device_model": getattr(teacher, "device_model", None) if teacher else None,
            "is_device_bound": bool(bound_id),
            "_photo_path": photo_raw.name if (photo_raw and hasattr(photo_raw, "name")) else None,
            "role": role,
            "system_role": role,
            "is_profile_completed": bool(profile and profile.is_profile_completed),
            "can_teach": can_teach,
            "is_teaching": False if role == "PARENT" else (can_teach or class_count > 0),
            "assigned_class_count": class_count,
            "is_superuser": user.is_superuser,
        }
        cache.set(cache_key, cached, timeout=30)

    school_meta = get_school_metadata(request)
    photo_url = build_media_url(f"/media/{cached['_photo_path']}", request) if cached.get("_photo_path") else None

    return {
        k: v for k, v in cached.items() if k != "_photo_path"
    } | {
        "photo": photo_url,
        "photo_url": photo_url,
        "school_name": school_meta.get("school_name", ""),
        "school_id": school_meta.get("school_id", ""),
        "school_logo": school_meta.get("school_logo"),
        "left_logo": school_meta.get("left_logo"),
        "right_logo": school_meta.get("right_logo"),
    }


def login_with_credentials(*, request, username: str, password: str) -> dict:
    clean_identifier = str(username or "").strip()[:100]
    raw_password = str(password or "")
    if not clean_identifier or not raw_password:
        raise AppError("MISSING_CREDENTIALS", "Enter both your username and password.", 400)

    existing_user = (
        User.objects.select_related("profile", "profile__teacher")
        .filter(
            Q(username__iexact=clean_identifier)
            | Q(profile__teacher__employee_id__iexact=clean_identifier)
        )
        .first()
    )
    profile = getattr(existing_user, "profile", None) if existing_user else None

    if profile and profile.is_locked():
        raise AppError(
            "ACCOUNT_LOCKED",
            "Too many failed sign-in attempts. Wait 15 minutes or ask your School Admin to unlock your account.",
            429,
        )

    if existing_user is None:
        User().set_password(raw_password)
        raise AppError("INVALID_CREDENTIALS", "Wrong username or password. Please try again.", 401)

    if not existing_user.is_active:
        User().set_password(raw_password)
        raise AppError("ACCOUNT_INACTIVE", "This account is inactive. Contact your School Admin.", 403)

    auth_user = authenticate(request=request, username=existing_user.username, password=raw_password)
    if auth_user is None:
        if profile:
            profile.record_failed_attempt()
        raise AppError("INVALID_CREDENTIALS", "Wrong username or password. Please try again.", 401)

    if profile:
        profile.reset_failed_attempts()

    return issue_session_for_user(auth_user, request)


def issue_session_for_user(auth_user, request=None) -> dict:
    legacy_token, _ = Token.objects.get_or_create(user=auth_user)
    refresh = RefreshToken.for_user(auth_user)
    return {
        "token": legacy_token.key,
        "access": str(refresh.access_token),
        "refresh": str(refresh),
        "user": build_user_session_payload(auth_user, request),
    }


DEMO_ROLE_MAP = {
    "ADMIN": ("demo_admin", ["ADMIN"]),
    "PRINCIPAL": ("demo_principal", ["PRINCIPAL"]),
    "DEPT_HEAD": ("demo_dept_head", ["DEPT_HEAD"]),
    "TEACHER": ("demo_teacher", ["FACULTY"]),
    "FACULTY": ("demo_teacher", ["FACULTY"]),
    "PARENT": ("demo_parent", ["PARENT"]),
}


def login_with_demo_role(*, request, role: str) -> dict:
    """Signs in a pre-seeded competition demo account by role (only called when Judge Demo Mode is enabled)."""
    key = str(role or "ADMIN").strip().upper()
    if key not in DEMO_ROLE_MAP:
        raise AppError(
            "INVALID_DEMO_ROLE",
            "Supported demo roles are: admin, principal, teacher, parent.",
            400,
        )

    preferred_username, profile_roles = DEMO_ROLE_MAP[key]
    user = (
        User.objects.select_related("profile", "profile__teacher")
        .filter(username__iexact=preferred_username, is_active=True)
        .first()
    )
    if user is None:
        user = (
            User.objects.select_related("profile", "profile__teacher")
            .filter(is_active=True, profile__role__in=profile_roles)
            .order_by("id")
            .first()
        )
    if user is None and key == "ADMIN":
        user = User.objects.filter(is_active=True, is_superuser=True).order_by("id").first()

    if user is None:
        raise AppError(
            "DEMO_NOT_SEEDED",
            "Competition demo accounts are not seeded yet. Run: python manage.py seed_competition_demo",
            404,
        )

    return issue_session_for_user(user, request)


@transaction.atomic
def update_own_profile(*, user, data: dict, files=None, request=None) -> dict:
    files = files or {}
    role = get_user_role(user)

    if "first_name" in data:
        user.first_name = str(data.get("first_name") or "").strip()[:150]
    if "last_name" in data:
        user.last_name = str(data.get("last_name") or "").strip()[:150]
    if "email" in data:
        clean_email = str(data.get("email") or "").strip().lower()[:150]
        if clean_email and User.objects.filter(email__iexact=clean_email).exclude(id=user.id).exists():
            raise AppError("EMAIL_TAKEN", "This email address is already used by another account.", 400)
        user.email = clean_email

    raw_password = str(data.get("password") or data.get("new_password") or "").strip()
    if raw_password:
        current_pw = str(data.get("current_password") or data.get("old_password") or "").strip()
        if user.has_usable_password() and current_pw and not user.check_password(current_pw):
            raise AppError("WRONG_CURRENT_PASSWORD", "Your current password is incorrect.", 400)
        try:
            validate_password(raw_password, user=user)
        except DjangoValidationError as exc:
            raise AppError("WEAK_PASSWORD", " ".join(exc.messages), 400)
        user.set_password(raw_password)

    user.save()

    if raw_password:
        Token.objects.filter(user=user).delete()

    raw_contact = str(data.get("contact_number") or data.get("phone_number") or "").strip()
    contact = normalize_ph_phone(raw_contact)[:30] if raw_contact else ""

    has_photo_key = any(k in data or k in files for k in ("photo", "avatar"))
    raw_photo = files.get("photo") or files.get("avatar") or data.get("photo") or data.get("avatar")

    clear_photo = has_photo_key and (raw_photo is None or str(raw_photo).strip().lower() in ("", "null", "none"))
    photo_file = None
    if has_photo_key and not clear_photo:
        decoded = decode_uploaded_image(raw_photo, prefix="avatar")
        if not isinstance(decoded, serializers.SkipField):
            photo_file = decoded

    profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=user)
    if contact and role != "PARENT":
        profile.phone_number = contact
    if clear_photo:
        profile.avatar = None
    elif photo_file:
        profile.avatar = photo_file
    profile.is_profile_completed = bool(user.first_name and user.last_name)
    profile.save()

    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    teacher_id = None
    if teacher:
        teacher_id = teacher.id
        if "first_name" in data and user.first_name:
            teacher.first_name = user.first_name[:100]
        if "middle_name" in data:
            teacher.middle_name = str(data.get("middle_name") or "").strip()[:100]
        if "last_name" in data and user.last_name:
            teacher.last_name = user.last_name[:100]
        if "suffix" in data:
            clean_suf = str(data.get("suffix") or "").strip()
            if clean_suf in VALID_SUFFIXES:
                teacher.suffix = clean_suf
        if contact:
            teacher.contact_number = contact[:50]
        if "email" in data:
            teacher.email = (user.email or "")[:150]
        if "department" in data and str(data.get("department") or "").strip():
            teacher.department = str(data.get("department")).strip()[:100]
        if "position" in data and str(data.get("position") or "").strip():
            teacher.position = str(data.get("position")).strip()[:100]
        if clear_photo:
            teacher.photo = None
        elif photo_file:
            photo_file.seek(0)
            teacher.photo = photo_file
        teacher.save()

    invalidate_user_and_teacher_caches(user_id=user.id, teacher_id=teacher_id)
    payload = build_user_session_payload(user, request)
    if raw_password:
        new_token, _ = Token.objects.get_or_create(user=user)
        payload["token"] = new_token.key
    return payload


@transaction.atomic
def reset_teacher_bound_device(*, teacher_id: int) -> TeacherProfile:
    teacher = TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("account").filter(id=teacher_id).first()
    if not teacher:
        raise AppError("TEACHER_NOT_FOUND", "Teacher profile not found.", 404)

    teacher.bound_device_id = None
    teacher.device_model = None
    teacher.device_bound_at = None
    teacher.save(update_fields=["bound_device_id", "device_model", "device_bound_at"])

    linked_account = getattr(teacher, "account", None)
    user_id = linked_account.user_id if linked_account else None

    invalidate_user_and_teacher_caches(user_id=user_id, teacher_id=teacher.id)
    return teacher


@transaction.atomic
def unlock_all_locked_accounts() -> int:
    """Clears failed login counters and temporary lockouts across all UserProfiles."""
    return UserProfile.objects.filter(Q(failed_attempts__gt=0) | Q(locked_until__isnull=False)).update(
        failed_attempts=0,
        locked_until=None,
    )

        self.assertTrue(val.data["is_taken"])

        # Register mobile push token
        pt = self.client.post("/api/v1/accounts/push-token/", {"push_token": "ExponentPushToken[test123]"}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(pt.status_code, 200)
        self.assertTrue(pt.data["registered"])

        # Reset device binding
        reset_res = self.client.post(f"/api/v1/accounts/reset-device/{self.faculty_profile.id}/", {}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(reset_res.status_code, 200)
        self.faculty_profile.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertIsNone(self.faculty_profile.bound_device_id)

        # Unlock accounts
        unlock_res = self.client.post("/api/v1/accounts/unlock-accounts/", {}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(unlock_res.status_code, 200)
        self.assertTrue(unlock_res.data["ok"])

        # Audit logs read
        logs_res = self.client.get("/api/v1/accounts/audit-logs/")
        self.assertEqual(logs_res.status_code, 200)
        self.assertIn("records", logs_res.data)

    def test_02_faculty_and_users_full_crud(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.admin_user)

        # Faculty CRUD (/v1/accounts/faculty/)
        create_f = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/accounts/faculty/",
            {
                "employee_id": "EMP-NEW-99",
                "first_name": "Carlos",
                "last_name": "Mendoza",
                "email": "carlos@attendsure.edu",
                "department": "Science",
                "position": "Faculty II",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(create_f.status_code, 201)
        fid = create_f.data["id"]

        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/accounts/faculty/").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/accounts/faculty/dropdown/").status_code, 200)

        upd_f = self.client.patch(f"/api/v1/accounts/faculty/{fid}/", {"position": "Master Faculty I"}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(upd_f.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(upd_f.data["position"], "Master Faculty I")

        del_f = self.client.delete(f"/api/v1/accounts/faculty/{fid}/")
        self.assertEqual(del_f.status_code, 204)

        # Users CRUD (/v1/accounts/users/) + self-delete guard
        create_u = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/accounts/users/",
            {
                "username": "temp_staff_user",
                "password": "TempPassword2026!",
                "first_name": "Ana",
                "last_name": "Cruz",
                "email": "ana@attendsure.edu",
                "employee_id": "EMP-ANA-01",
                "role": "FACULTY",
                "is_teaching": True,
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(create_u.status_code, 201)
        uid = create_u.data["id"]

        upd_u = self.client.patch(
            f"/api/v1/accounts/users/{uid}/",
            {"employee_id": "EMP-ANA-02", "department": "English"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(upd_u.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(upd_u.data["employee_id"], "EMP-ANA-02")
        self.assertEqual(upd_u.data["department"], "English")

        # Self-delete must be blocked with 400
        self_del = self.client.delete(f"/api/v1/accounts/users/{self.admin_user.id}/")
        self.assertEqual(self_del.status_code, 400)

        # Deleting other user succeeds
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete(f"/api/v1/accounts/users/{uid}/").status_code, 204)

    def test_05_attendance_qr_scan_offline_sync_manual_crud_and_exit_passes(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.faculty_user)

        # Signed QR Scan
        signed_qr = sign_student_qr(self.student.lrn, self.student.qr_token)
        scan = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/attendance/scan/",
            {"qr_text": signed_qr, "schedule_id": self.period.id},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(scan.status_code, 201)
        self.assertTrue(scan.data["ok"])

        # Offline Queue Sync (duplicate handling)
        sync = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/attendance/offline-sync/",
            {"scans": [{"qr_token": signed_qr, "schedule_id": self.period.id, "scanned_at": timezone.now().isoformat()}]},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(sync.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(sync.data["duplicate_count"], 1)

        # Assigned classes & adviser matrix
        classes = self.client.get("/api/v1/attendance/classes/")
        self.assertEqual(classes.status_code, 200)
        self.assertTrue(len(classes.data) >= 1)
        self.assertIsNotNone(classes.data[0]["students"][0]["attendance_record_id"])

        matrix = self.client.get("/api/v1/attendance/adviser-matrix/")
        self.assertEqual(matrix.status_code, 200)

        # Attendance Records Read / Update / Delete + Parent RBAC block
        recs = self.client.get("/api/v1/attendance/records/")
        self.assertEqual(recs.status_code, 200)
        rec_id = recs.data["records"][0]["id"]

        upd_rec = self.client.put("/api/v1/attendance/records/", {"id": rec_id, "status": "EXCUSED"}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(upd_rec.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(upd_rec.data["status"], "EXCUSED")

        # Parent cannot delete attendance record
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.parent_user)
        parent_del = self.client.delete(f"/api/v1/attendance/records/?id={rec_id}")
        self.assertEqual(parent_del.status_code, 403)

        # Faculty can delete attendance record
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.faculty_user)
        del_rec = self.client.delete(f"/api/v1/attendance/records/?id={rec_id}")
        self.assertEqual(del_rec.status_code, 200)

        # Re-create manual attendance
        man_c = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/attendance/records/",
            {"student_id": self.student.id, "schedule_id": self.period.id, "status": "PRESENT"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(man_c.status_code, 201)

        # Exit Passes full CRUD + Approve / Decline / Mark Used + PATCH preserves valid window
        now = timezone.now()
        ep_c = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/attendance/exit-passes/",
            {
                "bearer_type": "FACULTY",
                "pass_type": "Official Travel",
                "reason": "Division Math Seminar",
                "valid_from": now.isoformat(),
                "valid_until": (now + timedelta(hours=3)).isoformat(),
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(ep_c.status_code, 201)
        ep_id = ep_c.data["id"]
        orig_valid_until = ep_c.data["valid_until"]

        # Partial PATCH updating only reason must preserve valid_until
        ep_p = self.client.patch(f"/api/v1/attendance/exit-passes/{ep_id}/", {"reason": "Updated Seminar Location"}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(ep_p.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(ep_p.data["reason"], "Updated Seminar Location")
        self.assertEqual(ep_p.data["valid_until"], orig_valid_until)

        # Admin approves & marks used
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.admin_user)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(f"/api/v1/attendance/exit-passes/{ep_id}/approve/").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(f"/api/v1/attendance/exit-passes/{ep_id}/mark-used/").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete(f"/api/v1/attendance/exit-passes/{ep_id}/").status_code, 204)

    def test_06_campus_gps_messaging_chat_and_reports_full_crud(self):
        # Campus Boundary + Faculty Check-In + Audit + Anomalies + Emergency Roll-Call
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.admin_user)
        b_put = self.client.put(
            "/api/v1/campus/boundary/",
            {"name": "Main Campus", "latitude": 8.4858, "longitude": 124.6567, "radius_meters": 220},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(b_put.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(b_put.data["radius_meters"], 220)

        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.faculty_user)
        # Mismatched phone hardware ID must be rejected (1-to-1 device binding)
        bad_dev = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            {
                "latitude": 8.4858,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy": 10,
                "battery_level": 88,
                "face_verified": True,
                "liveness_passed": True,
                "client_device_id": "DEV-WRONG-999",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(bad_dev.status_code, 403)

        # Bound phone hardware ID succeeds
        chk = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            {
                "latitude": 8.4858,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy": 10,
                "battery_level": 88,
                "face_verified": True,
                "liveness_passed": True,
                "client_device_id": "DEV-ORIG-001",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(chk.status_code, 201)
        self.assertTrue(chk.data["is_inside_geofence"])

        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/campus/audit/").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/campus/anomalies/").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/campus/roll-call/").status_code, 200)

        # Parent must be blocked from emergency roll-call
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.parent_user)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/campus/roll-call/").status_code, 403)

        # Push Notifications Broadcast + Read + Update + Mark-Read + Delete
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.admin_user)
        notif_c = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/messaging/notifications/",
            {
                "title": "Early Dismissal",
                "message": "Classes end at 3:00 PM today.",
                "category": "ANNOUNCEMENT",
                "target_role": "PARENT",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(notif_c.status_code, 201)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(notif_c.data["dispatched_count"], 1)
        nid = notif_c.data["id"]

        notif_list = self.client.get("/api/v1/messaging/notifications/", {"scope": "all"})
        self.assertEqual(notif_list.status_code, 200)

        notif_u = self.client.patch(
            f"/api/v1/messaging/notifications/{nid}/",
            {"title": "Early Dismissal (Updated)"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(notif_u.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(notif_u.data["title"], "Early Dismissal (Updated)")

        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.parent_user)
        mr = self.client.post("/api/v1/messaging/notifications/mark-read/", {"ids": [nid]}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(mr.status_code, 200)

        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.admin_user)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete(f"/api/v1/messaging/notifications/{nid}/").status_code, 204)

        # Parent-Faculty Chat full CRUD
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.faculty_user)

        self.assertEqual(threads.status_code, 200)

            "/api/v1/messaging/messages/",
            {"student_id": self.student.id, "faculty_id": self.faculty_profile.id, "body": "Hello parent!"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(msg_c.status_code, 201)
        mid = msg_c.data["id"]

        msg_u = self.client.put("/api/v1/messaging/messages/", {"id": mid, "body": "Hello parent, updated!"}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(msg_u.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(msg_u.data["body"], "Hello parent, updated!")

        # Invalid message ID returns clean 400
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete("/api/v1/messaging/messages/?id=invalid").status_code, 400)

        # All Reports, Analytics, DTR Actions, Health & Cache Maintenance

        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/reports/sf2/", {"section_id": self.section.id, "month": now.month, "year": now.year}).status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/reports/sf4/", {"month": now.month, "year": now.year}).status_code, 200)

        # DTR submit & approve actions

            {"action": "SUBMIT_DTR", "faculty_id": self.faculty_profile.id, "month": now.month, "year": now.year, "regular_hours": "8:00 AM - 5:00 PM"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(dtr_sub.status_code, 200)
        dtr_app = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/reports/dtr/",
            {"action": "APPROVE_DEPT_HEAD", "faculty_id": self.faculty_profile.id, "month": now.month, "year": now.year},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(dtr_app.status_code, 200)

        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/reports/export/", {"type": "sf1", "section_id": self.section.id}).status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/reports/edfi-export/").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/reports/audit-logs/",
                {"action": "PRINT", "report_name": "SF1", "section_id": self.section.id, "document_tracking_id": "TRK-001"},
                format="json",
            ).status_code,
            201,
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/reports/audit-logs/").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/reports/dropout-risk/").status_code, 200)

        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/reports/system-status/").status_code, 200)

        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/v1/health/db/").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post("/api/v1/cache/flush/").status_code, 200)


def test_07_students_bulk_csv_class_list_import_and_rbac(self):
        from django.core.files.uploadedfile import SimpleUploadedFile

        csv_body = (
            "lrn,first_name,middle_name,last_name,suffix,sex,birthdate,section_name,grade_level,parent_contact,barangay,municipality_city,province\n"
            "127901260501,Miguel,Reyes,Navarro,,Male,2013-03-12,Diamond,Grade 7,09171234501,Macasandig,Cagayan de Oro City,Misamis Oriental\n"
            "127901260502,Angela,Cruz,Ramos,,Female,2013-08-24,Sapphire,Grade 8,09171234502,Nazareth,Cagayan de Oro City,Misamis Oriental\n"
            "BADLRN,Invalid,Row,Test,,Male,2013-01-01,Diamond,Grade 7,09171234503,Carmen,Cagayan de Oro City,Misamis Oriental\n"
        ).encode("utf-8")

        # Non-leadership faculty must be blocked (403)
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.faculty_user)
        denied = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/students/bulk-import/",
            {"file": SimpleUploadedFile("class_list.csv", csv_body, content_type="text/csv")},
            format="multipart",
        )
        self.assertEqual(denied.status_code, 403)

        # School leadership imports valid rows, auto-creates Sapphire, and skips invalid LRN
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.admin_user)
        res1 = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/students/bulk-import/",
            {"file": SimpleUploadedFile("class_list.csv", csv_body, content_type="text/csv")},
            format="multipart",
        )
        self.assertEqual(res1.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(res1.data["created_count"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(res1.data["skipped_count"], 1)

        # Re-uploading updates existing LRNs cleanly without duplicating students
        res2 = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/students/bulk-import/",
            {"file": SimpleUploadedFile("class_list.csv", csv_body, content_type="text/csv")},
            format="multipart",
        )
        self.assertEqual(res2.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(res2.data["created_count"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(res2.data["updated_count"], 2)

class SecurityAndUtilityUnitTests(APITestCase):
    def test_international_and_ph_phone_normalization(self):
        self.assertEqual(normalize_ph_phone("0917-123-4567"), "+639171234567")
        self.assertEqual(normalize_ph_phone("9171234567"), "+639171234567")
        self.assertEqual(normalize_ph_phone("639171234567"), "+639171234567")
        self.assertEqual(normalize_international_phone("+1 (415) 555-0199"), "+14155550199")
        self.assertEqual(normalize_international_phone("+44 7700 900077"), "+447700900077")
        self.assertEqual(normalize_international_phone("0065 9123 4567"), "+6591234567")
        self.assertEqual(normalize_international_phone(""), "")

    def test_gps_distance_handles_finite_and_invalid_values(self):
        dist = calculate_distance_meters(8.4858, 124.6567, 8.4858, 124.6567)
        self.assertEqual(dist, 0.0)
        self.assertTrue(math.isinf(calculate_distance_meters(float("nan"), 124.6567, 8.4858, 124.6567)))
        self.assertTrue(math.isinf(calculate_distance_meters(float("inf"), 124.6567, 8.4858, 124.6567)))
        verdict = verify_campus_gps(
            latitude=float("inf"),
            longitude=124.6567,
            campus_lat=8.4858,
            campus_lon=124.6567,
            accuracy_meters=float("nan"),
        )
        self.assertFalse(verdict["is_valid"])
        self.assertFalse(verdict["is_inside"])

    @override_settings(ALLOW_LEGACY_UNSIGNED_QR=False)
    def test_qr_signer_accepts_signed_and_rejects_unsigned_by_default(self):
        signed = sign_student_qr("127901269999", "STU-TOKEN-999")
        verified = verify_student_qr(signed)
        self.assertIsNotNone(verified)
        self.assertTrue(verified.is_signed)
        self.assertEqual(verified.lrn, "127901269999")
        self.assertEqual(verified.qr_token, "STU-TOKEN-999")

        self.assertIsNone(verify_student_qr("STU-TOKEN-999"))
        self.assertIsNone(verify_student_qr("ATTENDSURE:127901269999:STU-TOKEN-999:FORGED000000"))

    def test_empty_email_parent_cannot_hijack_teacher_profile(self):
        TeacherProfile.objects.create(
            employee_id="EMP-EMPTY-1",
            first_name="Real",
            last_name="Teacher",
            email="",
            is_active=True,
        )
        parent_user = User.objects.create_user(username="parent_empty", password="Password123!", email="")
        UserProfile.objects.create(user=parent_user, role="PARENT")

        self.assertIsNone(resolve_teacher_for_user(parent_user))

    def test_expired_lockout_resets_counter_on_next_failure(self):
        u = User.objects.create_user(username="lock_tester", password="Password123!")
        profile = UserProfile.objects.create(
            user=u,
            role="FACULTY",
            failed_attempts=5,
            locked_until=timezone.now() - timezone.timedelta(minutes=5),
        )
        self.assertFalse(profile.is_locked())
        profile.record_failed_attempt()
        profile.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(profile.failed_attempts, 1)
        self.assertIsNone(profile.locked_until)

    def test_edfi_v6_export_standard_and_gdpr_pseudonymized_and_rbac(self):
        # Non-leaders cannot export Ed-Fi datasets
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.teacher_user)
        denied = self.client.get("/api/v1/reports/edfi-export/")
        self.assertEqual(denied.status_code, 403)

        # Leaders receive Ed-Fi v6.0 standard export
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.admin_user)
        std_res = self.client.get("/api/v1/reports/edfi-export/?days=14&anonymize=0")
        self.assertEqual(std_res.status_code, 200)
        std_json = std_res.json()
        self.assertEqual(std_json["edFiVersion"], "6.0")
        self.assertEqual(std_json["privacyMode"], "STANDARD_INSTITUTIONAL")
        self.assertEqual(std_json["students"][0]["firstName"], "Sofia")
        self.assertEqual(std_json["students"][0]["studentUniqueId"], "127901269999")

        # GDPR pseudonymized mode strips PII and replaces LRN with deterministic SHA-256 pseudonym
        anon_res = self.client.get("/api/v1/reports/edfi-export/?days=14&anonymize=1")
        self.assertEqual(anon_res.status_code, 200)
        anon_json = anon_res.json()
        self.assertEqual(anon_json["privacyMode"], "GDPR_PSEUDONYMIZED")
        self.assertNotIn("firstName", anon_json["students"][0])
        self.assertTrue(anon_json["students"][0]["studentUniqueId"].startswith("STU-"))
        self.assertEqual(anon_json["students"][0]["birthDate"], "2012-01-01")

    def test_seed_competition_demo_command_is_idempotent(self):
        call_command("seed_competition_demo", verbosity=0)
        count_first = Student.objects.count()
        call_command("seed_competition_demo", verbosity=0)
        count_second = Student.objects.count()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(count_first, 24)
        self.assertEqual(count_first, count_second)

def _format_audit_row(row: AuditLog) -> dict:
    local_dt = timezone.localtime(row.created_at)
    actor = row.performed_by
    actor_name = (actor.get_full_name() or actor.username) if actor else "system"

    details_parts = []
    if getattr(row, "changed_fields", None):
        details_parts.append(f"Updated: {', '.join(str(f) for f in row.changed_fields)}")
    elif getattr(row, "new_data", None) and isinstance(row.new_data, dict):
        summary = ", ".join(
            f"{k}={v}" for k, v in list(row.new_data.items())[:3] if str(k).lower() not in ("password", "token")
        )
        if summary:
            details_parts.append(summary)

    return {
        "id": row.id,
        "timestamp": local_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p"),
        "time_only": local_dt.strftime("%I:%M:%S %p"),
        "date_only": local_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "user": actor_name,
        "username": actor.username if actor else "system",
        "action": row.action,
        "module": row.table_name,
        "details": " • ".join(details_parts) or f"{row.action} on {row.table_name} #{row.record_id}",
        "ip_address": row.client_ip or "",
        "status": "SUCCESS",
    }


class LoginView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.AllowAny]

    def post(self, request):
        username = str(request.data.get("username") or "")
        password = str(request.data.get("password") or "")
        payload = login_with_credentials(request=request, username=username, password=password)
        user_obj = payload.get("user") or {}
        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="auth_user",
            record_id=int(user_obj.get("id") or 0),
            action="LOGIN",
            new_data={"username": user_obj.get("username", username)},
        )
        return Response(payload, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

class DemoLoginView(APIView):
    """1-Click Judge Demo sign-in. Strictly disabled (404) when DEBUG=False and ENABLE_JUDGE_DEMO=False."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.AllowAny]

    def post(self, request):
        if not _is_judge_demo_enabled():
            return Response(
                {"error": "Judge Demo Mode is disabled in this environment."},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )
        role = str(request.data.get("role") or "admin").strip()
        payload = login_with_demo_role(request=request, role=role)
        user_obj = payload.get("user") or {}
        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="auth_user",
            record_id=int(user_obj.get("id") or 0),
            action="DEMO_LOGIN",
            new_data={"role": role, "username": user_obj.get("username", "")},
        )
        return Response(payload, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class CurrentUserView(APIView):
    """Returns and updates the signed-in user's profile."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        return Response(build_user_session_payload(request.user, request))

    def put(self, request):
        payload = update_own_profile(
            user=request.user,
            data=request.data,
            files=request.FILES,
            request=request,
        )
        changed_keys = [
            str(k)
            for k in (request.data.keys() if hasattr(request.data, "keys") else ["profile"])
            if str(k).lower() not in ("password", "current_password", "new_password")
        ]
        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="auth_user",
            record_id=request.user.id,
            action="PROFILE",
            changed_fields=changed_keys or ["profile"],
        )
        return Response(payload, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

    def patch(self, request):
        return self.put(request)


MeView = CurrentUserView
CurrentProfileView = CurrentUserView


class ValidateFieldView(APIView):
    """Checks if a username, employee_id, or email is already used (Staff/Leaders only)."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsStaffOrFaculty]

    def get(self, request):
        field = str(request.query_params.get("field") or "username").strip().lower()
        value = str(request.query_params.get("value") or "").strip()[:254]
        exclude_raw = request.query_params.get("exclude_id")
        exclude_id = int(exclude_raw) if (exclude_raw and str(exclude_raw).isdigit()) else None

        if not value:
            return Response({"is_taken": False, "valid": True, "message": ""})

        is_taken = False
        message = ""

        if field == "username":
            qs = User.objects.filter(username__iexact=value)
            if exclude_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_id)
            is_taken = qs.exists()
            if is_taken:
                message = "Username is already taken."
        elif field == "employee_id":
            qs = TeacherProfile.objects.filter(employee_id__iexact=value)
            if exclude_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(account__user_id=exclude_id).exclude(id=exclude_id)
            is_taken = qs.exists()
            if is_taken:
                message = "Employee ID is already assigned."
        elif field == "email":
            qs = User.objects.filter(email__iexact=value)
            if exclude_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_id)
            is_taken = qs.exists()
            if is_taken:
                message = "Email address is already in use."

        return Response({"is_taken": is_taken, "valid": not is_taken, "message": message})


class PushTokenUpdateView(APIView):
    """Saves the mobile push notification token for the signed-in user."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request):
        token = str(
            request.data.get("push_token")
            or request.data.get("expo_push_token")
            or request.data.get("token")
            or ""
        ).strip()[:255]
        profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=request.user)
        profile.push_token = token or None
        profile.save(update_fields=["push_token"])
        return Response({"ok": True, "registered": bool(token)})


SavePushTokenView = PushTokenUpdateView


class ResetDeviceLockView(APIView):
    """Clears the phone hardware lock on a teacher profile so a replacement phone can be paired."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, pk: int | None = None):
        role = get_user_role(request.user)
        if not (request.user.is_superuser or role in ("ADMIN", "SUPERADMIN", "PRINCIPAL")):
            raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "Only School Principals or System Admins can reset device locks.", 403)

        target_id = pk or request.data.get("teacher_id") or request.data.get("faculty_id")
        if not target_id or not str(target_id).isdigit():
            raise AppError("INVALID_ID", "A valid teacher ID is required.", 400)

        teacher = reset_teacher_bound_device(teacher_id=int(target_id))
        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name=teacher._meta.db_table,
            record_id=teacher.id,
            action="SECURITY",
            new_data={"reset_device_for": teacher.full_name},
        )
        return Response({"ok": True, "message": f"Phone hardware lock cleared for {teacher.full_name}."})


ResetDeviceBindingView = ResetDeviceLockView

            }
        )


class AuditLogListView(APIView):
    """Returns user activity and security audit logs."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        leader = is_school_leader(request.user)
        qs = AuditLog.objects.select_related("performed_by").order_by("-created_at")
        if not leader:
            qs = qs.filter(performed_by=request.user)

        search = str(request.query_params.get("search") or "").strip()[:80]
        action_filter = str(request.query_params.get("action") or "ALL").strip().upper()
        date_filter = str(request.query_params.get("date") or "").strip()

        if action_filter and action_filter != "ALL":
            qs = qs.filter(action__icontains=action_filter)
        if date_filter:
            try:
                parsed_date = dt_date.fromisoformat(date_filter)
                qs = qs.filter(created_at__date=parsed_date)
            except ValueError:
                raise AppError("INVALID_DATE", "Date filter must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.", 400)
        if search:
            qs = qs.filter(
                Q(performed_by__username__icontains=search)
                | Q(performed_by__first_name__icontains=search)
                | Q(performed_by__last_name__icontains=search)
                | Q(action__icontains=search)
                | Q(table_name__icontains=search)
            )

        records = [_format_audit_row(row) for row in qs[:150]]
        return Response(
            {
                "is_admin": leader,
                "count": len(records),
                "records": records,
                "results": records,
            }
        )


ActivityLogListView = AuditLogListView


class AuditLogViewSet(viewsets.ReadOnlyModelViewSet):
    """Read-only viewset for audit log entries."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get_queryset(self):
        qs = AuditLog.objects.select_related("performed_by").order_by("-created_at")
        if not is_school_leader(self.request.user):
            qs = qs.filter(performed_by=self.request.user)
        return qs

    def list(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        return AuditLogListView().get(request)

    def retrieve(self, request, pk=None, *args, **kwargs):
        if not pk or not str(pk).isdigit():
            return Response({"error": "Invalid audit log ID."}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        row = self.get_queryset().filter(pk=int(pk)).first()
        if not row:
            return Response({"error": "Audit log entry not found."}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)
        return Response(_format_audit_row(row))


class TeacherViewSet(AuditedModelViewSet):
    queryset = TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("account").order_by("last_name", "first_name")
    serializer_class = TeacherSerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsLeadershipOrStaffReadOnly]

    def get_queryset(self):
        qs = super().get_queryset()
        dept = self.request.query_params.get("department", "").strip()
        search = self.request.query_params.get("search", "").strip()[:80]
        if dept:
            qs = qs.filter(department__iexact=dept)
        if search:
            qs = qs.filter(
                Q(employee_id__icontains=search)
                | Q(first_name__icontains=search)
                | Q(last_name__icontains=search)
                | Q(position__icontains=search)
                | Q(department__icontains=search)
            )
        return qs

    def perform_create(self, serializer):
        super().perform_create(serializer)
        invalidate_user_and_teacher_caches(teacher_id=serializer.instance.id)

    def perform_update(self, serializer):
        super().perform_update(serializer)
        account = getattr(serializer.instance, "account", None)
        invalidate_user_and_teacher_caches(
            user_id=account.user_id if account else None,
            teacher_id=serializer.instance.id,
        )

    def perform_destroy(self, instance):
        account = getattr(instance, "account", None)
        user_id = account.user_id if account else None
        teacher_id = instance.id
        super().perform_destroy(instance)
        invalidate_user_and_teacher_caches(user_id=user_id, teacher_id=teacher_id)

    @action(
        detail=False,
        methods=["get"],
        url_path="dropdown",
        permission_classes=[permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsStaffOrFaculty],
    )
    def dropdown(self, request):
        include_all = str(request.query_params.get("include_all", "")).lower() in ("1", "true", "yes")
        cache_key = "teachers:dropdown:all" if include_all else "teachers:dropdown:active"
        rows = cache.get(cache_key)
        if rows is None:
            qs = TeacherProfile.objects.order_by("last_name", "first_name")
            if not include_all:
                qs = qs.filter(is_active=True)
            rows = list(
                qs.only(
                    "id",
                    "employee_id",
                    "first_name",
                    "middle_name",
                    "last_name",
                    "suffix",
                    "department",
                    "position",
                    "contact_number",
                    "email",
                    "can_teach",
                    "is_active",
                    "photo",
                )
            )
            cache.set(cache_key, rows, timeout=30)

        return Response(TeacherDropdownSerializer(rows, many=True, context={"request": request}).data)


class UserAccountViewSet(AuditedModelViewSet):
    queryset = User.objects.select_related("profile", "profile__teacher").order_by("username")
    serializer_class = UserAccountSerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsSystemAdmin]

    def get_queryset(self):
        qs = super().get_queryset()
        search = self.request.query_params.get("search", "").strip()[:80]
        if search:
            qs = qs.filter(
                Q(username__icontains=search)
                | Q(first_name__icontains=search)
                | Q(last_name__icontains=search)
                | Q(email__icontains=search)
            )
        return qs

    def perform_create(self, serializer):
        super().perform_create(serializer)
        prof = getattr(serializer.instance, "profile", None)
        invalidate_user_and_teacher_caches(
            user_id=serializer.instance.id,
            teacher_id=prof.teacher_id if prof else None,
        )

    def perform_update(self, serializer):
        super().perform_update(serializer)
        prof = getattr(serializer.instance, "profile", None)
        invalidate_user_and_teacher_caches(
            user_id=serializer.instance.id,
            teacher_id=prof.teacher_id if prof else None,
        )

    def perform_destroy(self, instance):
        if instance.id == self.request.user.id:
            raise AppError("SELF_DELETE_FORBIDDEN", "You cannot delete your own currently signed-in account.", 400)
        user_id = instance.id
        prof = getattr(instance, "profile", None)
        teacher_id = prof.teacher_id if prof else None
        super().perform_destroy(instance)
        invalidate_user_and_teacher_caches(user_id=user_id, teacher_id=teacher_id)

from django.db.models import Q
from django.utils import timezone
from common.media import build_media_url
from common.permissions import get_user_role, is_school_leader
from apps.accounts.selectors import (
    get_teacher_section_ids,
    get_teacher_student_ids,
    resolve_teacher_for_user,
)
